sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Stack Colors! is a color-matching game. The objective is simple – transport as many bricks of the same color as possible while avoiding those of different colors. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as straightforward as it seems. As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new characters, obstacles, and power-ups that will change the way you play. For example, certain characters will grant you a temporary boost in speed or accuracy, while others will slow you down or swap your bricks.

The controls are also worth mentioning. With the simple swipe gesture, you can move your character left or right, and the game will automatically stack the bricks for you. It's a clever mechanic that allows you to focus on strategy rather than manual dexterity. But what really sets Stack Colors! apart is its dynamic difficulty adjustment. The game will adapt to your skill level, introducing new challenges and obstacles as you progress. This means that even experienced players will find themselves constantly challenged and engaged.

One of the key features of Stack Colors! is its focus on pattern recognition and spatial reasoning. As you stack bricks, you need to think several steps ahead, anticipating the outcome of your actions and adjusting your strategy accordingly. It's a cognitive challenge that will keep your brain sharp and your reflexes quick. But don't worry – the game is also designed to be accessible and fun for players of all ages and skill levels.
